create.name: Dr. Marie Mbouni
create.bio:
Dr. Marie Mbouni grew up in Cameroon and trained as a physician, working for many years as an anaesthesiologist in the United States. She describes feeling a pull towards healing from childhood, and after a long medical career she turned to shamanism, energy work and ceremony, studying cross-cultural shamanic traditions, sound and ancestral practices. She now works as a spiritual guide, consciousness coach and ceremony facilitator, and has been called the entrepreneur's shaman for her work with founders, leaders and creatives.

Her teaching joins ritual and ceremony with practical coaching: she offers group and one-to-one mentoring built around what she calls her SuperCreator method, and leads ceremonies and devotional practices that draw on goddess traditions, the Medicine Wheel, breathwork and the cycles of the moon. On The Shift Network she teaches courses on ceremony and on the inner path of the medicine woman, and she shares guided meditations, rituals and a 13-day goddess devotion series on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: The Medicine Woman Within
courses.description: A self-paced video course that follows the directions of the Medicine Wheel as a ceremonial path. Through myth, storytelling and intuitive practices, Dr. Marie guides you to recognise your gifts and find your voice in service to others.

courses.title: Group & One-on-One Mentoring
courses.description: Mentoring in heart-led leadership based on her SuperCreator method, offered as a six- or twelve-month group programme with video lessons and fortnightly live coaching calls, or as one-to-one mentoring. Entry is by application and a short clarity call.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 1.32K subscribers (channel page @DrMarieMbouni, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram @mariembounimd and Facebook /mariembounimd counts could not be read without login → well under 100k → local_hero
flags: Physician (former anaesthesiologist): checked strictly. Her work as listed is shamanic, ceremonial and coaching, not medical treatment, but her Iboga course, her book blurb and some testimonials make healing claims, all left out.

Her only book, Healing the Five Wounds of the Heart (Hierophant, 2023, ASIN 1950253430), was left out because the blurb by a 'medical doctor' promises recovery from trauma and 'good health'; a human may decide it is acceptable (the wounds are emotional: abandonment, betrayal, separation, denial, judgment).
'The Medicine Woman Within' kept: 'medicine' refers to the Medicine Wheel and the medicine-woman path, not to medical care; a human should confirm.
No email is published; the only contact route is the mentoring application form (apply-now).
Instagram and Facebook follower counts could not be read.
The best headshot comes from her own site's CDN (cdn.filesafe.space); same person as the Shift photo and the YouTube avatar.
The 'Day N' devotion videos belong to a 13-day series, so they read as a set; titles are copied as published (emoji removed).
left_out: Spiritual Healing Lessons From Iboga (Shift Network course): sales page names trauma, anxiety, insomnia and psychedelic medicine.
Becoming a Ceremony Keeper (Shift Network professional training, 8 Oct 2026 to 25 Feb 2027, $1,799 USD): already under way, so dated.
Healing the Five Wounds of the Heart (book): blurb promises trauma recovery and good health (see flags).

Interviews on other channels such as 'The Power of Iboga: Reclaiming Your Life from Trauma, Addiction, and Disease' and 'Healing Trauma with Iboga': health claims; others are podcast conversations where she is a guest.
'The 2026 Timeline Activates During Scorpio New Moon', dated eclipse and new-moon ceremony recordings (2018, 2019): dated.
Short clips under 2 minutes ('Shamanic Healing with Marie Mbouni LOVE').
Free resources: 'My Favorite 3 Shamanic Tools' is on her Teachable school, which is offline; the free 13-Day Devotion has no stable public URL found. None verified.
